first boot: Building the harness: a bridge into the emulator, savestates, and a first map of the game's memory.
Level 1 solved: Finding where the toad's position, health and enemies live in memory; trying Start on every frame to find the title skip; working out that one headbutt kills a pig, and where the hidden portal is.
Turbo Tunnel: to the bike: The rat recipe and the pit map: every pit on this stretch was found by dying into it in a practice run and adding a jump.
Turbo Tunnel done: The bike course: a wall-reading policy, then a beam search for the last section where walls arrive every 21 frames.
Level 4 done: Seven checkpoint walls, each its own puzzle - ice balls to stop, lift and throw, snowmen, moving platforms, spiked balls. Dozens of searches, most of them dead ends first.
Level 6 done: Snake geometry: which head to ride, where it pauses, and the double jump off the last one. Plus the research on which tricks the speedrun rules allow.
Level 8 done: A new 'climb' search mode for the tower, and a boss mode that ranks by smashes landed on Robo-Manus.
Terra Tubes done: Decoding a tool-assisted run frame by frame to get the out-of-bounds route, then teaching the search to follow its path and wait for each gear.
Rat Race done: Racing the rat down the shaft, and the rat boot: two exact kicks found by search.
Clinger-Winger done: Writing a legal controller for the unicycle maze (the reference run's Up+Down is banned) and the Buzzball fight.
Revolution: the camera locks: Discovering why platforms never appeared: live enemies lock the camera. Every kill and sprint had to be re-derived legally.
Revolution: three wind faces: Two days on one tower: platforms that only launch from an exact pixel, a boss that waits on the random number generator, wind that blows you off unless you hang on a pole.
The Revolution done: The top of the tower without the banned camera trick: tiny platforms, a spring, and holding A until the level ends.
The Dark Queen: Finding her hit counter in memory, then searching for 21 hits without taking one.
